tables.name: sales.orders
tables.fact_owner: Customer commitment before custody, revenue, tax, or accounting posting.

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_status
checks.expression: status IN ('draft','submitted','approved','partially_fulfilled','fulfilled','cancelled')

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_year
checks.expression: fiscal_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_money
checks.expression: subtotal>=0 AND discount_total>=0 AND charges_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total>=0 AND cgst_total>=0 AND sgst_total>=0 AND igst_total>=0 AND cess_total>=0 AND grand_total>=0

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_approval
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('approved','partially_fulfilled','fulfilled') OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_net_gst_totals
checks.expression: net_value_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total>=0 AND gst_taxable_total<=net_value_total

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_document_discount_kind_basis
checks.expression: document_discount_kind IN ('none','percent','amount') AND document_discount_basis IN ('taxable_value','price_value')

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_document_discount_value
checks.expression: (document_discount_kind='none' AND document_discount_value=0) OR (document_discount_kind='percent' AND document_discount_value>=0 AND document_discount_value<=100) OR (document_discount_kind='amount' AND document_discount_value>=0 AND document_discount_value=round(document_discount_value,2))

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_supply_type
checks.expression: supply_type IN ('intra_state','inter_state','export','sez')

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_zero_rated_payment_mode
checks.expression: zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('not_applicable','without_payment','with_igst') AND ((supply_type IN ('export','sez') AND zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('without_payment','with_igst')) OR (supply_type NOT IN ('export','sez') AND zero_rated_payment_mode='not_applicable'))

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_rounding_policy
checks.expression: rounding_policy IN ('none','nearest_rupee') AND ((rounding_policy='none' AND rounding_adjustment=0 AND grand_total=net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END)) OR (rounding_policy='nearest_rupee' AND grand_total=round(net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END),0) AND rounding_adjustment=grand_total-(net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END)) AND abs(rounding_adjustment)<=0.50))

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_tax_charge_mechanism
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND ((tax_charge_mechanism='normal' AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=0) OR (tax_charge_mechanism='reverse_charge' AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total))

checks.name: ck_sales_orders_tax_component_totals
checks.expression: ((supply_type='intra_state') AND igst_total=0 AND cgst_total=sgst_total) OR ((supply_type IN ('inter_state','export','sez')) AND cgst_total=0 AND sgst_total=0)

indexes.name: ix_sales_orders_customer_status
indexes.purpose: Customer order history and fulfilment queue.

cross_row_invariants.name: sales_orders_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Approval recomputes typed product and charge lines and header amounts under calculation_ruleset_version, validates effective HSN/SAC tax versions on order_date, and freezes approved commercial terms. Header net_value_total and gst_taxable_total must equal their rounded line sums. Persist document_discount_kind, document_discount_basis, and document_discount_value; discount_total must equal line_discount_amount plus allocated document_discount_amount across lines. zero_rated taxability is valid only for export/SEZ: zero_rated_payment_mode without_payment requires zero GST, while with_igst requires IGST only and preserves refund context. rounding_policy is immutable and pre-round net value plus tax components plus rounding_adjustment must equal grand_total. tax_charge_mechanism is uniform across lines: normal tax is part of counterparty grand_total; reverse_charge tax is excluded from payable and summed in recipient_assessed_tax_total.

tables.name: sales.order_lines
tables.fact_owner: An ordered product quantity and immutable commercial/tax calculation snapshot.

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_line_kind
checks.expression: line_kind IN ('product','charge')

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_charge_code
checks.expression: charge_code IS NULL OR charge_code IN ('freight','packing','insurance','handling','other')

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_price_basis
checks.expression: price_basis IN ('tax_exclusive','tax_inclusive')

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_free_supply_tax_treatment
checks.expression: (line_kind='product' AND free_supply_tax_treatment IN ('excluded_from_taxable_value','included_at_unit_rate')) OR (line_kind='charge' AND free_supply_tax_treatment IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_uom_conversion
checks.expression: line_kind='charge' OR (base_billed_quantity=round(billed_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6) AND base_free_quantity=round(free_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6))

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_typed_payload
checks.expression: (line_kind='product' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_code IS NULL AND uom_code IS NOT NULL AND uom_conversion_factor IS NOT NULL AND uom_conversion_factor>0 AND billed_quantity IS NOT NULL AND free_quantity IS NOT NULL AND base_billed_quantity IS NOT NULL AND base_free_quantity IS NOT NULL AND billed_quantity>=0 AND free_quantity>=0 AND billed_quantity+free_quantity>0 AND base_billed_quantity>=0 AND base_free_quantity>=0 AND base_billed_quantity+base_free_quantity>0 AND free_supply_tax_treatment IS NOT NULL AND quoted_unit_rate IS NOT NULL AND quoted_unit_rate>=0) OR (line_kind='charge' AND product_id IS NULL AND charge_code IS NOT NULL AND uom_code IS NULL AND uom_conversion_factor IS NULL AND billed_quantity IS NULL AND free_quantity IS NULL AND base_billed_quantity IS NULL AND base_free_quantity IS NULL AND free_supply_tax_treatment IS NULL AND quoted_unit_rate IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_money
checks.expression: gross_amount>=0 AND line_discount_amount>=0 AND line_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND document_discount_amount>=0 AND document_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND cgst_amount>=0 AND sgst_amount>=0 AND igst_amount>=0 AND cess_amount>=0 AND line_total>=0

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_tax_rates
checks.expression: cgst_rate>=0 AND sgst_rate>=0 AND igst_rate>=0 AND cess_rate>=0

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_line_discount_kind_basis
checks.expression: line_discount_kind IN ('none','percent','amount') AND line_discount_basis IN ('taxable_value','price_value') AND (line_kind<>'charge' OR line_discount_kind='none')

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_line_discount_value
checks.expression: (line_discount_kind='none' AND line_discount_value=0) OR (line_discount_kind='percent' AND line_discount_value>=0 AND line_discount_value<=100) OR (line_discount_kind='amount' AND line_discount_value>=0 AND line_discount_value=round(line_discount_value,2))

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_discount_outputs
checks.expression: line_discount_amount>=0 AND line_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND document_discount_amount>=0 AND document_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND net_value_amount>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND gst_taxable_value<=net_value_amount

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_taxability_snapshot
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated','exempt','nil_rated','non_gst')

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_taxability_value_shape
checks.expression: (taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated') AND gst_taxable_value=net_value_amount) OR (taxability_snapshot IN ('exempt','nil_rated','non_gst') AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND igst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0)

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_zero_rated_tax
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated' OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0)

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_tax_charge_mechanism
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND (tax_charge_mechanism<>'reverse_charge' OR (price_basis='tax_exclusive' AND taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated' AND line_discount_basis='taxable_value'))

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_reverse_charge_payable
checks.expression: (tax_charge_mechanism='normal' AND line_total=net_value_amount+cgst_amount+sgst_amount+igst_amount+cess_amount) OR (tax_charge_mechanism='reverse_charge' AND line_total=net_value_amount)

checks.name: ck_sales_order_lines_tax_component_shape
checks.expression: (igst_rate=0 AND cgst_rate=sgst_rate AND cgst_amount=sgst_amount) OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0)

cross_row_invariants.name: sales_order_lines_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: For product rows, derive base_billed_quantity and base_free_quantity from the immutable uom_conversion_factor at six-decimal precision. Recompute product quantities or typed charge amounts using the persisted tax-exclusive or tax-inclusive price_basis; apply the explicit free_supply_tax_treatment to product gross value, then discounts, taxable value, tax amounts, and line total. Reject tax_code_version_id outside its effective period. Only product lines may be dispatched, reserved, or allocated. Persist line discount kind/basis/value, document-discount eligibility and both nominal/taxable discount allocations; all outputs must match the canonical engine exactly. taxability_snapshot must match the effective tax-code default, except zero_rated is allowed only for qualifying export/SEZ header context with preserved ITC/refund treatment. net_value_amount retains all pre-tax payable value while gst_taxable_value excludes exempt, nil-rated and non-GST value. For zero_rated lines, enforce the header mode: without_payment has zero components; with_igst permits only IGST and must match the effective rate. tax_charge_mechanism must equal the header; reverse_charge requires tax-exclusive pricing and pre-tax discount basis, records compliance tax components, and excludes those components from line_total. Intra-state component rates and rounded amounts have exact CGST=SGST equality; inter-state/zero-rated-with-IGST has zero CGST and SGST.

cross_row_invariants.name: sales_dispatches_invariant_1

cross_row_invariants.name: sales_invoices_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Posting accepts only tax_invoice or bill_of_supply; credit and debit adjustments are owned by finance.adjustment_notes. It recomputes and verifies typed product/charge lines and header totals, validates HSN/SAC tax versions on invoice_date, freezes tax snapshots, and creates exactly one tax document, receivable open item, and accounting event. Header net_value_total and gst_taxable_total must equal their rounded line sums. Persist document_discount_kind, document_discount_basis, and document_discount_value; discount_total must equal line_discount_amount plus allocated document_discount_amount across lines. zero_rated taxability is valid only for export/SEZ: zero_rated_payment_mode without_payment requires zero GST, while with_igst requires IGST only and preserves refund context. rounding_policy is immutable and pre-round net value plus tax components plus rounding_adjustment must equal grand_total. tax_charge_mechanism is uniform across lines: normal tax is part of counterparty grand_total; reverse_charge tax is excluded from payable and summed in recipient_assessed_tax_total. Posting must carry the mechanism and recipient-assessed components and zero organization self-assessed tax into exactly one tax.documents record and accounting event for liability and eligible ITC treatment.

cross_row_invariants.name: sales_invoices_invariant_2
cross_row_invariants.rule: An invoice owns exactly one typed inventory document when at least one product line is direct_issue. Each product line has exactly one fulfillment source: direct lines are represented exactly once in the invoice-owned issue, while dispatch-allocated lines have exact posted dispatch allocation lineage and never issue stock again. Mixed invoices remain one atomic commercial aggregate without double stock or COGS.

checks.expression: rounding_policy IN ('none','nearest_rupee') AND ((rounding_policy='none' AND rounding_adjustment=0 AND grand_total=net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END)) OR (rounding_policy='nearest_rupee' AND grand_total=round(net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END),0) AND rounding_adjustment=grand_total-(net_value_total+(CASE WHEN tax_charge_mechanism='normal' THEN cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total ELSE 0 END)) AND abs(rounding_adjustment)<=0.50))

checks.name: ck_sales_returns_tax_charge_mechanism
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND ((tax_charge_mechanism='normal' AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=0) OR (tax_charge_mechanism='reverse_charge' AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=cgst_total+sgst_total+igst_total+cess_total))

checks.name: ck_sales_returns_tax_component_totals
checks.expression: (igst_total=0 AND cgst_total=sgst_total) OR (cgst_total=0 AND sgst_total=0)

checks.name: ck_sales_returns_gst_tax_treatment
checks.expression: gst_tax_treatment IN ('statutory','commercial_only') AND ((gst_tax_treatment='statutory' AND recipient_itc_reversal_evidence_attachment_id IS NOT NULL AND recipient_itc_reversal_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (gst_tax_treatment='commercial_only' AND recipient_itc_reversal_evidence_attachment_id IS NULL AND recipient_itc_reversal_confirmed_at IS NULL AND gst_taxable_total=0 AND cgst_total=0 AND sgst_total=0 AND igst_total=0 AND cess_total=0 AND recipient_assessed_tax_total=0))

indexes.name: ix_sales_returns_invoice
indexes.purpose: Original-invoice return ceiling and audit history.

cross_row_invariants.name: sales_returns_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Posting locks the exact active tax.gst_adjustment_rule_versions row for the sales credit/decrease reason and return date, recomputes the credit from return lines using the original invoice tax versions, and freezes evidence. A statutory GST credit requires retained buyer-ITC-reversal evidence, satisfies the effective rule deadline, and creates exactly one decreasing tax document; a commercial_only credit remains a receivable adjustment but has zero GST components and creates no tax document. Every path creates exactly one accounting event and a typed inventory receipt when disposition is return-to-stock. Header net_value_total and gst_taxable_total must equal their rounded line sums. zero_rated_payment_mode must copy the original invoice mode and reverse the same without_payment zero-tax or with_igst IGST-paid treatment. Sales returns always preserve zero organization self-assessed tax; recipient_assessed_tax_total represents only the locked original reverse-charge context. rounding_policy is immutable and pre-round net value plus tax components plus rounding_adjustment must equal grand_total. Return rounding_policy copies the original; only the final cumulative reversal may absorb the deterministic residual, and cumulative reversed value may not exceed the original. tax_charge_mechanism is uniform across lines: normal tax is part of counterparty grand_total; reverse_charge tax is excluded from payable and summed in recipient_assessed_tax_total.

tables.name: sales.return_lines
tables.fact_owner: Batch-specific returned billed/free quantity and original tax-credit snapshot.

checks.name: ck_return_lines_quantity
checks.expression: billed_quantity>=0 AND free_quantity>=0 AND billed_quantity+free_quantity>0 AND uom_conversion_factor>0 AND base_billed_quantity>=0 AND base_free_quantity>=0 AND base_billed_quantity+base_free_quantity>0

checks.name: ck_return_lines_reversal_value_basis
checks.expression: reversal_value_basis IN ('billed_quantity','base_quantity')

checks.name: ck_return_lines_disposition
checks.expression: disposition IN ('return_to_stock','quarantine','destroy')

checks.name: ck_return_lines_money
checks.expression: quoted_unit_rate>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND cgst_amount>=0 AND sgst_amount>=0 AND igst_amount>=0 AND cess_amount>=0 AND line_total>=0

checks.name: ck_return_lines_tax_rates
checks.expression: cgst_rate>=0 AND sgst_rate>=0 AND igst_rate>=0 AND cess_rate>=0

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_price_basis
checks.expression: price_basis IN ('tax_exclusive','tax_inclusive')

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_free_supply_tax_treatment
checks.expression: free_supply_tax_treatment IN ('excluded_from_taxable_value','included_at_unit_rate')

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_uom_conversion
checks.expression: base_billed_quantity=round(billed_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6) AND base_free_quantity=round(free_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6)

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_billed_reversal_basis
checks.expression: reversal_value_basis<>'billed_quantity' OR billed_quantity>0

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_taxability_snapshot
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated','exempt','nil_rated','non_gst')

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_taxability_value_shape
checks.expression: gst_tax_treatment IN ('statutory','commercial_only') AND net_value_amount>=0 AND gst_taxable_value>=0 AND ((gst_tax_treatment='commercial_only' AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0) OR (gst_tax_treatment='statutory' AND ((taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated') AND gst_taxable_value=net_value_amount) OR (taxability_snapshot IN ('exempt','nil_rated','non_gst') AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND igst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0))))

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_zero_rated_tax
checks.expression: taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated' OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cess_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0)

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_tax_charge_mechanism
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND (tax_charge_mechanism<>'reverse_charge' OR (price_basis='tax_exclusive' AND taxability_snapshot<>'zero_rated'))

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_reverse_charge_payable
checks.expression: (tax_charge_mechanism='normal' AND line_total=net_value_amount+cgst_amount+sgst_amount+igst_amount+cess_amount) OR (tax_charge_mechanism='reverse_charge' AND line_total=net_value_amount)

checks.name: ck_sales_return_lines_tax_component_shape
checks.expression: (igst_rate=0 AND cgst_rate=sgst_rate AND cgst_amount=sgst_amount) OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0)

cross_row_invariants.name: sales_return_lines_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Under locked originals, an allocated return may not exceed its invoice-dispatch allocation and a direct-invoice return may not exceed its invoice line or typed inventory issue. Compute the reversal ratio only from the explicit reversal_value_basis of billed_quantity or base_quantity; persisted final_residual must equal the consumed calculation artifact. Tax version, product, batch, prices, and tax snapshots must match the credited original. Preserve the original quoted_unit_rate, price_basis, and free_supply_tax_treatment as immutable reversal evidence. Persist billed_quantity, free_quantity and uom_conversion_factor; their rounded six-decimal base quantities and factor must match the original line, so reversal_value_basis never inverts rounded base quantities. taxability_snapshot, net_value_amount and gst_taxable_value must match the reversed original components; zero_rated remains valid only under the original qualifying export/SEZ context. For zero_rated lines, enforce the header mode: without_payment has zero components; with_igst permits only IGST and must match the effective rate. tax_charge_mechanism must equal the header; reverse_charge requires tax-exclusive pricing and pre-tax discount basis, records compliance tax components, and excludes those components from line_total. Intra-state component rates and rounded amounts have exact CGST=SGST equality; inter-state/zero-rated-with-IGST has zero CGST and SGST.
